2146// Performs conversion in floats
2147struct Lab2RGBfloat
2148{
2149 typedef float channel_type;
2150
2151 Lab2RGBfloat( int _dstcn, int _blueIdx, const float* _coeffs,
2152 const float* _whitept, bool _srgb )
2153 : dstcn(_dstcn), srgb(_srgb), blueIdx(_blueIdx)
2154 {
2155 initLabTabs();
2156
2157 softdouble whitePt[3];
2158 for(int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
2159 if(_whitept)
2160 whitePt[i] = softdouble((double)_whitept[i]);
2161 else
2162 whitePt[i] = D65[i];
2163
2164 for( int i = 0; i < 3; i++ )
2165 {
2166 softdouble c[3];
2167 for(int j = 0; j < 3; j++)
2168 if(_coeffs)
2169 c[j] = softdouble(_coeffs[i+j*3]);
2170 else
2171 c[j] = XYZ2sRGB_D65[i+j*3];
2172
2173 coeffs[i+(blueIdx^2)*3] = (float)(c[0]*whitePt[i]);
2174 coeffs[i+3] = (float)(c[1]*whitePt[i]);
2175 coeffs[i+blueIdx*3] = (float)(c[2]*whitePt[i]);
2176 }
2177
2178 lThresh = softfloat(8); // 0.008856f * 903.3f = (6/29)^3*(29/3)^3 = 8
2179 fThresh = softfloat(6)/softfloat(29); // 7.787f * 0.008856f + 16.0f / 116.0f = 6/29
2180 }
2181
2182 void operator()(const float* src, float* dst, int n) const
2183 {
2184 CV_INSTRUMENT_REGION();
2185
2186 int i = 0, dcn = dstcn;
2187 const float* gammaTab = srgb ? sRGBInvGammaTab : 0;
2188 float gscale = GammaTabScale;
2189 float C0 = coeffs[0], C1 = coeffs[1], C2 = coeffs[2],
2190 C3 = coeffs[3], C4 = coeffs[4], C5 = coeffs[5],
2191 C6 = coeffs[6], C7 = coeffs[7], C8 = coeffs[8];
2192 float alpha = ColorChannel<float>::max();
2193
2194#if CV_SIMD
2195 const int vsize = VTraits<v_float32>::vlanes();
2196 const int nrepeats = 2;
2197 v_float32 v16_116 = vx_setall_f32(16.0f / 116.0f);
2198 for( ; i <= n-vsize*nrepeats;
2199 i += vsize*nrepeats, src += 3*vsize*nrepeats, dst += dcn*vsize*nrepeats)
2200 {
2201 v_float32 li[nrepeats], ai[nrepeats], bi[nrepeats];
2202 for(int k = 0; k < nrepeats; k++)
2203 {
2204 v_load_deinterleave(src + k*3*vsize, li[k], ai[k], bi[k]);
2205 }
2206
2207 v_float32 x[nrepeats], y[nrepeats], z[nrepeats], fy[nrepeats];
2208 v_float32 limask[nrepeats];
2209 v_float32 vlThresh = vx_setall_f32(lThresh);
2210 for(int k = 0; k < nrepeats; k++)
2211 {
2212 limask[k] = v_le(li[k], vlThresh);
2213 }
2214 v_float32 ylo[nrepeats], yhi[nrepeats], fylo[nrepeats], fyhi[nrepeats];
2215 // 903.3 = (29/3)^3, 7.787 = (29/3)^3/(29*4)
2216 v_float32 vinv903 = vx_setall_f32(1.f/903.3f);
2217 for(int k = 0; k < nrepeats; k++)
2218 {
2219 ylo[k] = v_mul(li[k], vinv903);
2220 }
2221 v_float32 v7787 = vx_setall_f32(7.787f);
2222 for(int k = 0; k < nrepeats; k++)
2223 {
2224 fylo[k] = v_fma(v7787, ylo[k], v16_116);
2225 }
2226 v_float32 v16 = vx_setall_f32(16.0f), vinv116 = vx_setall_f32(1.f/116.0f);
2227 for(int k = 0; k < nrepeats; k++)
2228 {
2229 fyhi[k] = v_mul(v_add(li[k], v16), vinv116);
2230 }
2231 for(int k = 0; k < nrepeats; k++)
2232 {
2233 yhi[k] = v_mul(fyhi[k], fyhi[k], fyhi[k]);
2234 }
2235 for(int k = 0; k < nrepeats; k++)
2236 {
2237 y[k] = v_select(limask[k], ylo[k], yhi[k]);
2238 fy[k] = v_select(limask[k], fylo[k], fyhi[k]);
2239 }
2240
2241 v_float32 fxz[nrepeats*2];
2242 v_float32 vpinv500 = vx_setall_f32( 1.f/500.f);
2243 v_float32 vninv200 = vx_setall_f32(-1.f/200.f);
2244 for(int k = 0; k < nrepeats; k++)
2245 {
2246 fxz[k*2+0] = v_fma(ai[k], vpinv500, fy[k]);
2247 fxz[k*2+1] = v_fma(bi[k], vninv200, fy[k]);
2248 }
2249 v_float32 vfTresh = vx_setall_f32(fThresh);
2250 v_float32 vinv7787 = vx_setall_f32(1.f/7.787f);
2251 for(int k = 0; k < nrepeats; k++)
2252 {
2253 for (int j = 0; j < 2; j++)
2254 {
2255 v_float32 f = fxz[k*2+j];
2256 v_float32 fmask = v_le(f, vfTresh);
2257 v_float32 flo = v_mul(v_sub(f, v16_116), vinv7787);
2258 v_float32 fhi = v_mul(v_mul(f, f), f);
2259 fxz[k*2+j] = v_select(fmask, flo, fhi);
2260 }
2261 }
2262 for(int k = 0; k < nrepeats; k++)
2263 {
2264 x[k] = fxz[k*2+0], z[k] = fxz[k*2+1];
2265 }
2266 v_float32 ro[nrepeats], go[nrepeats], bo[nrepeats];
2267 v_float32 vc0 = vx_setall_f32(C0), vc1 = vx_setall_f32(C1), vc2 = vx_setall_f32(C2);
2268 v_float32 vc3 = vx_setall_f32(C3), vc4 = vx_setall_f32(C4), vc5 = vx_setall_f32(C5);
2269 v_float32 vc6 = vx_setall_f32(C6), vc7 = vx_setall_f32(C7), vc8 = vx_setall_f32(C8);
2270 for(int k = 0; k < nrepeats; k++)
2271 {
2272 ro[k] = v_fma(vc0, x[k], v_fma(vc1, y[k], v_mul(vc2, z[k])));
2273 go[k] = v_fma(vc3, x[k], v_fma(vc4, y[k], v_mul(vc5, z[k])));
2274 bo[k] = v_fma(vc6, x[k], v_fma(vc7, y[k], v_mul(vc8, z[k])));
2275 }
2276 v_float32 one = vx_setall_f32(1.f), zero = vx_setzero_f32();
2277 for(int k = 0; k < nrepeats; k++)
2278 {
2279 ro[k] = v_max(zero, v_min(ro[k], one));
2280 go[k] = v_max(zero, v_min(go[k], one));
2281 bo[k] = v_max(zero, v_min(bo[k], one));
2282 }
2283
2284 if (gammaTab)
2285 {
2286 v_float32 vgscale = vx_setall_f32(gscale);
2287 for(int k = 0; k < nrepeats; k++)
2288 {
2289 ro[k] = v_mul(ro[k], vgscale);
2290 go[k] = v_mul(go[k], vgscale);
2291 bo[k] = v_mul(bo[k], vgscale);
2292 }
2293
2294 for(int k = 0; k < nrepeats; k++)
2295 {
2296 ro[k] = splineInterpolate(ro[k], gammaTab, GAMMA_TAB_SIZE);
2297 go[k] = splineInterpolate(go[k], gammaTab, GAMMA_TAB_SIZE);
2298 bo[k] = splineInterpolate(bo[k], gammaTab, GAMMA_TAB_SIZE);
2299 }
2300 }
2301
2302 if(dcn == 4)
2303 {
2304 v_float32 valpha = vx_setall_f32(alpha);
2305 for(int k = 0; k < nrepeats; k++)
2306 {
2307 v_store_interleave(dst + 4*vsize*k, ro[k], go[k], bo[k], valpha);
2308 }
2309 }
2310 else // dcn == 3
2311 {
2312 for(int k = 0; k < nrepeats; k++)
2313 {
2314 v_store_interleave(dst + 3*vsize*k, ro[k], go[k], bo[k]);
2315 }
2316 }
2317 }
2318#endif
2319 for (; i < n; i++, src += 3, dst += dcn)
2320 {
2321 float li = src[0];
2322 float ai = src[1];
2323 float bi = src[2];
2324
2325 // 903.3 = (29/3)^3, 7.787 = (29/3)^3/(29*4)
2326 float y, fy;
2327 if (li <= lThresh)
2328 {
2329 y = li / 903.3f;
2330 fy = 7.787f * y + 16.0f / 116.0f;
2331 }
2332 else
2333 {
2334 fy = (li + 16.0f) / 116.0f;
2335 y = fy * fy * fy;
2336 }
2337
2338 float fxz[] = { ai / 500.0f + fy, fy - bi / 200.0f };
2339
2340 for (int j = 0; j < 2; j++)
2341 if (fxz[j] <= fThresh)
2342 fxz[j] = (fxz[j] - 16.0f / 116.0f) / 7.787f;
2343 else
2344 fxz[j] = fxz[j] * fxz[j] * fxz[j];
2345
2346 float x = fxz[0], z = fxz[1];
2347 float ro = C0 * x + C1 * y + C2 * z;
2348 float go = C3 * x + C4 * y + C5 * z;
2349 float bo = C6 * x + C7 * y + C8 * z;
2350 ro = clip(ro);
2351 go = clip(go);
2352 bo = clip(bo);
2353
2354 if (gammaTab)
2355 {
2356 ro = splineInterpolate(ro * gscale, gammaTab, GAMMA_TAB_SIZE);
2357 go = splineInterpolate(go * gscale, gammaTab, GAMMA_TAB_SIZE);
2358 bo = splineInterpolate(bo * gscale, gammaTab, GAMMA_TAB_SIZE);
2359 }
2360
2361 dst[0] = ro, dst[1] = go, dst[2] = bo;
2362 if( dcn == 4 )
2363 dst[3] = alpha;
2364 }
2365 }
2366
2367 int dstcn;
2368 float coeffs[9];
2369 bool srgb;
2370 float lThresh;
2371 float fThresh;
2372 int blueIdx;
2373};
2374
2375
2376// Performs conversion in integers
2377struct Lab2RGBinteger
2378{
2379 typedef uchar channel_type;
2380
2381 static const int base_shift = 14;
2382 static const int BASE = (1 << base_shift);
2383 // lThresh == (6/29)^3 * (29/3)^3 * BASE/100
2384 static const int lThresh = 1311;
2385 // fThresh == ((29/3)^3/(29*4) * (6/29)^3 + 16/116)*BASE
2386 static const int fThresh = 3390;
2387 // base16_116 == BASE*16/116
2388 static const int base16_116 = 2260;
2389 static const int shift = lab_shift+(base_shift-inv_gamma_shift);
2390
2391 Lab2RGBinteger( int _dstcn, int blueIdx, const float* _coeffs,
2392 const float* _whitept, bool srgb )
2393 : dstcn(_dstcn), issRGB(srgb)
2394 {
2395 softdouble whitePt[3];
2396 for(int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
2397 if(_whitept)
2398 whitePt[i] = softdouble(_whitept[i]);
2399 else
2400 whitePt[i] = D65[i];
2401
2402 static const softdouble lshift(1 << lab_shift);
2403 for(int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
2404 {
2405 softdouble c[3];
2406 for(int j = 0; j < 3; j++)
2407 if(_coeffs)
2408 c[j] = softdouble(_coeffs[i+j*3]);
2409 else
2410 c[j] = XYZ2sRGB_D65[i+j*3];
2411
2412 coeffs[i+(blueIdx)*3] = cvRound(lshift*c[0]*whitePt[i]);
2413 coeffs[i+3] = cvRound(lshift*c[1]*whitePt[i]);
2414 coeffs[i+(blueIdx^2)*3] = cvRound(lshift*c[2]*whitePt[i]);
2415 }
2416 }
2417
2418 // L, a, b should be in their natural range
2419 inline void process(const uchar LL, const uchar aa, const uchar bb, int& ro, int& go, int& bo) const
2420 {
2421 int x, y, z;
2422 int ify;
2423
2424 y = LabToYF_b[LL*2 ];
2425 ify = LabToYF_b[LL*2+1];
2426
2427 //float fxz[] = { ai / 500.0f + fy, fy - bi / 200.0f };
2428 int adiv, bdiv;
2429 //adiv = aa*BASE/500 - 128*BASE/500, bdiv = bb*BASE/200 - 128*BASE/200;
2430 //approximations with reasonable precision
2431 adiv = ((5*aa*53687 + (1 << 7)) >> 13) - 128*BASE/500;
2432 bdiv = (( bb*41943 + (1 << 4)) >> 9) - 128*BASE/200+1;
2433
2434 int ifxz[] = {ify + adiv, ify - bdiv};
2435
2436 for(int k = 0; k < 2; k++)
2437 {
2438 int& v = ifxz[k];
2439 v = abToXZ_b[v-minABvalue];
2440 }
2441 x = ifxz[0]; /* y = y */; z = ifxz[1];
2442
2443 int C0 = coeffs[0], C1 = coeffs[1], C2 = coeffs[2];
2444 int C3 = coeffs[3], C4 = coeffs[4], C5 = coeffs[5];
2445 int C6 = coeffs[6], C7 = coeffs[7], C8 = coeffs[8];
2446
2447 ro = CV_DESCALE(C0 * x + C1 * y + C2 * z, shift);
2448 go = CV_DESCALE(C3 * x + C4 * y + C5 * z, shift);
2449 bo = CV_DESCALE(C6 * x + C7 * y + C8 * z, shift);
2450
2451 ro = max(0, min((int)INV_GAMMA_TAB_SIZE-1, ro));
2452 go = max(0, min((int)INV_GAMMA_TAB_SIZE-1, go));
2453 bo = max(0, min((int)INV_GAMMA_TAB_SIZE-1, bo));
2454
2455 if(issRGB)
2456 {
2457 ushort* tab = sRGBInvGammaTab_b;
2458 ro = tab[ro];
2459 go = tab[go];
2460 bo = tab[bo];
2461 }
2462 else
2463 {
2464 // rgb = (rgb*255) >> inv_gamma_shift
2465 ro = ((ro << 8) - ro) >> inv_gamma_shift;
2466 go = ((go << 8) - go) >> inv_gamma_shift;
2467 bo = ((bo << 8) - bo) >> inv_gamma_shift;
2468 }
2469 }
2470
2471#if CV_SIMD
2472 inline void processLabToXYZ(const v_uint8& l, const v_uint8& a, const v_uint8& b,
2473 v_int32 (&xiv)[4], v_int32 (&y)[4], v_int32 (&ziv)[4]) const
2474 {
2475 v_uint16 l0, l1;
2476 v_expand(l, l0, l1);
2477 v_int32 lq[4];
2478 v_expand(v_reinterpret_as_s16(l0), lq[0], lq[1]);
2479 v_expand(v_reinterpret_as_s16(l1), lq[2], lq[3]);
2480
2481 // Load Y and IFY values from lookup-table
2482 // y = LabToYF_b[L_value*2], ify = LabToYF_b[L_value*2 + 1]
2483 // LabToYF_b[i*2 ] = y; // 0 <= y <= BASE
2484 // LabToYF_b[i*2+1] = ify; // 2260 <= ify <= BASE
2485 v_int32 yf[4];
2486 v_int32 ify[4];
2487 v_int32 mask16 = vx_setall_s32(0xFFFF);
2488 for(int k = 0; k < 4; k++)
2489 {
2490 yf[k] = v_lut((const int*)LabToYF_b, lq[k]);
2491 y[k] = v_and(yf[k], mask16);
2492 ify[k] = v_reinterpret_as_s32(v_shr(v_reinterpret_as_u32(yf[k]), 16));
2493 }
2494
2495 v_int16 ify0, ify1;
2496 ify0 = v_pack(ify[0], ify[1]);
2497 ify1 = v_pack(ify[2], ify[3]);
2498
2499 v_int16 adiv0, adiv1, bdiv0, bdiv1;
2500 v_uint16 a0, a1, b0, b1;
2501 v_expand(a, a0, a1); v_expand(b, b0, b1);
2502 //adiv = aa*BASE/500 - 128*BASE/500, bdiv = bb*BASE/200 - 128*BASE/200;
2503 //approximations with reasonable precision
2504 v_uint16 mulA = vx_setall_u16(53687);
2505 v_uint32 ma[4];
2506 v_uint32 addA = vx_setall_u32(1 << 7);
2507 v_mul_expand((v_add(a0, v_shl<2>(a0))), mulA, ma[0], ma[1]);
2508 v_mul_expand((v_add(a1, v_shl<2>(a1))), mulA, ma[2], ma[3]);
2509 adiv0 = v_reinterpret_as_s16(v_pack((v_shr<13>(v_add(ma[0], addA))), (v_shr<13>(v_add(ma[1], addA)))));
2510 adiv1 = v_reinterpret_as_s16(v_pack((v_shr<13>(v_add(ma[2], addA))), (v_shr<13>(v_add(ma[3], addA)))));
2511
2512 v_uint16 mulB = vx_setall_u16(41943);
2513 v_uint32 mb[4];
2514 v_uint32 addB = vx_setall_u32(1 << 4);
2515 v_mul_expand(b0, mulB, mb[0], mb[1]);
2516 v_mul_expand(b1, mulB, mb[2], mb[3]);
2517 bdiv0 = v_reinterpret_as_s16(v_pack(v_shr<9>(v_add(mb[0], addB)), v_shr<9>(v_add(mb[1], addB))));
2518 bdiv1 = v_reinterpret_as_s16(v_pack(v_shr<9>(v_add(mb[2], addB)), v_shr<9>(v_add(mb[3], addB))));
2519
2520 // 0 <= adiv <= 8356, 0 <= bdiv <= 20890
2521 /* x = ifxz[0]; y = y; z = ifxz[1]; */
2522 v_uint16 xiv0, xiv1, ziv0, ziv1;
2523 v_int16 vSubA = vx_setall_s16(-128*BASE/500 - minABvalue), vSubB = vx_setall_s16(128*BASE/200-1 - minABvalue);
2524
2525 // int ifxz[] = {ify + adiv, ify - bdiv};
2526 // ifxz[k] = abToXZ_b[ifxz[k]-minABvalue];
2527 xiv0 = v_reinterpret_as_u16(v_add_wrap(v_add_wrap(ify0, adiv0), vSubA));
2528 xiv1 = v_reinterpret_as_u16(v_add_wrap(v_add_wrap(ify1, adiv1), vSubA));
2529 ziv0 = v_reinterpret_as_u16(v_add_wrap(v_sub_wrap(ify0, bdiv0), vSubB));
2530 ziv1 = v_reinterpret_as_u16(v_add_wrap(v_sub_wrap(ify1, bdiv1), vSubB));
2531
2532 v_uint32 uxiv[4], uziv[4];
2533 v_expand(xiv0, uxiv[0], uxiv[1]);
2534 v_expand(xiv1, uxiv[2], uxiv[3]);
2535 v_expand(ziv0, uziv[0], uziv[1]);
2536 v_expand(ziv1, uziv[2], uziv[3]);
2537
2538 for(int k = 0; k < 4; k++)
2539 {
2540 xiv[k] = v_lut(abToXZ_b, v_reinterpret_as_s32(uxiv[k]));
2541 ziv[k] = v_lut(abToXZ_b, v_reinterpret_as_s32(uziv[k]));
2542 }
2543 // abToXZ_b[i-minABvalue] = v; // -1335 <= v <= 88231
2544 }
2545#endif
2546
2547 void operator()(const uchar* src, uchar* dst, int n) const
2548 {
2549 CV_INSTRUMENT_REGION();
2550
2551 int i, dcn = dstcn;
2552 uchar alpha = ColorChannel<uchar>::max();
2553
2554 i = 0;
2555
2556#if CV_SIMD
2557 if(enablePackedLab)
2558 {
2559 bool srgb = issRGB;
2560 ushort* tab = sRGBInvGammaTab_b;
2561 const int vsize = VTraits<v_uint8>::vlanes();
2562 v_uint8 valpha = vx_setall_u8(alpha);
2563 v_int32 vc[9];
2564 for(int k = 0; k < 9; k++)
2565 {
2566 vc[k] = vx_setall_s32(coeffs[k]);
2567 }
2568 const int descaleShift = 1 << (shift-1);
2569 v_int32 vdescale = vx_setall_s32(descaleShift);
2570 for ( ; i <= n-vsize;
2571 i += vsize, src += 3*vsize, dst += dcn*vsize)
2572 {
2573 v_uint8 l, a, b;
2574 v_load_deinterleave(src, l, a, b);
2575
2576 v_int32 xq[4], yq[4], zq[4];
2577 processLabToXYZ(l, a, b, xq, yq, zq);
2578
2579 // x, y, z exceed 2^16 so we cannot do v_mul_expand or v_dotprod
2580 v_int32 rq[4], gq[4], bq[4];
2581 for(int k = 0; k < 4; k++)
2582 {
2583 rq[k] = v_shr<shift>(v_add(v_add(v_add(v_mul(vc[0], xq[k]), v_mul(vc[1], yq[k])), v_mul(vc[2], zq[k])), vdescale));
2584 gq[k] = v_shr<shift>(v_add(v_add(v_add(v_mul(vc[3], xq[k]), v_mul(vc[4], yq[k])), v_mul(vc[5], zq[k])), vdescale));
2585 bq[k] = v_shr<shift>(v_add(v_add(v_add(v_mul(vc[6], xq[k]), v_mul(vc[7], yq[k])), v_mul(vc[8], zq[k])), vdescale));
2586 }
2587
2588 //limit indices in table and then substitute
2589 //ro = tab[ro]; go = tab[go]; bo = tab[bo];
2590 v_int32 z = vx_setzero_s32(), up = vx_setall_s32((int)INV_GAMMA_TAB_SIZE-1);
2591 for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++)
2592 {
2593 rq[k] = v_max(z, v_min(up, rq[k]));
2594 gq[k] = v_max(z, v_min(up, gq[k]));
2595 bq[k] = v_max(z, v_min(up, bq[k]));
2596 }
2597
2598 v_uint16 rgb[6];
2599 if(srgb)
2600 {
2601 // [RRR... , GGG... , BBB...]
2602 int32_t CV_DECL_ALIGNED(CV_SIMD_WIDTH) vidx[VTraits<v_uint8>::max_nlanes*3];
2603 for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++)
2604 v_store_aligned(vidx + 0*vsize + k*vsize/4, rq[k]);
2605 for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++)
2606 v_store_aligned(vidx + 1*vsize + k*vsize/4, gq[k]);
2607 for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++)
2608 v_store_aligned(vidx + 2*vsize + k*vsize/4, bq[k]);
2609
2610 rgb[0] = vx_lut(tab, vidx + 0*vsize/2);
2611 rgb[1] = vx_lut(tab, vidx + 1*vsize/2);
2612 rgb[2] = vx_lut(tab, vidx + 2*vsize/2);
2613 rgb[3] = vx_lut(tab, vidx + 3*vsize/2);
2614 rgb[4] = vx_lut(tab, vidx + 4*vsize/2);
2615 rgb[5] = vx_lut(tab, vidx + 5*vsize/2);
2616 }
2617 else
2618 {
2619 // rgb = (rgb*255) >> inv_gamma_shift
2620 for(int k = 0; k < 4; k++)
2621 {
2622 rq[k] = v_shr((v_sub(v_shl(rq[k], 8), rq[k])), inv_gamma_shift);
2623 gq[k] = v_shr((v_sub(v_shl(gq[k], 8), gq[k])), inv_gamma_shift);
2624 bq[k] = v_shr((v_sub(v_shl(bq[k], 8), bq[k])), inv_gamma_shift);
2625 }
2626 rgb[0] = v_reinterpret_as_u16(v_pack(rq[0], rq[1]));
2627 rgb[1] = v_reinterpret_as_u16(v_pack(rq[2], rq[3]));
2628 rgb[2] = v_reinterpret_as_u16(v_pack(gq[0], gq[1]));
2629 rgb[3] = v_reinterpret_as_u16(v_pack(gq[2], gq[3]));
2630 rgb[4] = v_reinterpret_as_u16(v_pack(bq[0], bq[1]));
2631 rgb[5] = v_reinterpret_as_u16(v_pack(bq[2], bq[3]));
2632 }
2633
2634 v_uint16 R0, R1, G0, G1, B0, B1;
2635
2636 v_uint8 R, G, B;
2637 R = v_pack(rgb[0], rgb[1]);
2638 G = v_pack(rgb[2], rgb[3]);
2639 B = v_pack(rgb[4], rgb[5]);
2640
2641 if(dcn == 4)
2642 {
2643 v_store_interleave(dst, B, G, R, valpha);
2644 }
2645 else // dcn == 3
2646 {
2647 v_store_interleave(dst, B, G, R);
2648 }
2649 }
2650 }
2651#endif
2652
2653 for (; i < n; i++, src += 3, dst += dcn)
2654 {
2655 int ro, go, bo;
2656 process(src[0], src[1], src[2], ro, go, bo);
2657
2658 dst[0] = saturate_cast<uchar>(bo);
2659 dst[1] = saturate_cast<uchar>(go);
2660 dst[2] = saturate_cast<uchar>(ro);
2661 if( dcn == 4 )
2662 dst[3] = alpha;
2663 }
2664 }
2665
2666 int dstcn;
2667 int coeffs[9];
2668 bool issRGB;
2669};
2670
2671
2672struct Lab2RGB_f
2673{
2674 typedef float channel_type;
2675
2676 Lab2RGB_f( int _dstcn, int _blueIdx, const float* _coeffs,
2677 const float* _whitept, bool _srgb )
2678 : fcvt(_dstcn, _blueIdx, _coeffs, _whitept, _srgb), dstcn(_dstcn)
2679 { }
2680
2681 void operator()(const float* src, float* dst, int n) const
2682 {
2683 fcvt(src, dst, n);
2684 }
2685
2686 Lab2RGBfloat fcvt;
2687 int dstcn;
2688};
2689
2690
2691struct Lab2RGB_b
2692{
2693 typedef uchar channel_type;
2694
2695 Lab2RGB_b( int _dstcn, int _blueIdx, const float* _coeffs,
2696 const float* _whitept, bool _srgb )
2697 : fcvt(3, _blueIdx, _coeffs, _whitept, _srgb ), icvt(_dstcn, _blueIdx, _coeffs, _whitept, _srgb), dstcn(_dstcn)
2698 { }
2699
2700 void operator()(const uchar* src, uchar* dst, int n) const
2701 {
2702 CV_INSTRUMENT_REGION();
2703
2704 if(enableBitExactness)
2705 {
2706 icvt(src, dst, n);
2707 return;
2708 }
2709
2710 int i, j, dcn = dstcn;
2711 uchar alpha = ColorChannel<uchar>::max();
2712#if CV_SIMD
2713 float CV_DECL_ALIGNED(CV_SIMD_WIDTH) buf[3*BLOCK_SIZE];
2714#else
2715 float CV_DECL_ALIGNED(16) buf[3*BLOCK_SIZE];
2716#endif
2717
2718 static const softfloat fl = softfloat(100)/f255;
2719
2720#if CV_SIMD
2721 const int fsize = VTraits<v_float32>::vlanes();
2722 v_float32 vl = vx_setall_f32((float)fl);
2723 v_float32 va = vx_setall_f32(1.f);
2724 v_float32 vb = vx_setall_f32(1.f);
2725 v_float32 vaLow = vx_setall_f32(-128.f), vbLow = vx_setall_f32(-128.f);
2726 //TODO: fix that when v_interleave is available
2727 float CV_DECL_ALIGNED(CV_SIMD_WIDTH) interTmpM[VTraits<v_float32>::max_nlanes*3], interTmpA[VTraits<v_float32>::max_nlanes*3];
2728 v_store_interleave(interTmpM, vl, va, vb);
2729 v_store_interleave(interTmpA, vx_setzero_f32(), vaLow, vbLow);
2730 v_float32 mluv[3], aluv[3];
2731 for(int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
2732 {
2733 mluv[k] = vx_load_aligned(interTmpM + k*fsize);
2734 aluv[k] = vx_load_aligned(interTmpA + k*fsize);
2735 }
2736#endif
2737
2738 i = 0;
2739 for(; i < n; i += BLOCK_SIZE, src += BLOCK_SIZE*3 )
2740 {
2741 int dn = std::min(n - i, (int)BLOCK_SIZE);
2742 j = 0;
2743
2744#if CV_SIMD
2745 const int vsize = VTraits<v_uint8>::vlanes();
2746 for( ; j <= (dn - vsize)*3; j += 3*vsize )
2747 {
2748 v_uint8 s0, s1, s2;
2749 s0 = vx_load(src + j + 0*vsize);
2750 s1 = vx_load(src + j + 1*vsize);
2751 s2 = vx_load(src + j + 2*vsize);
2752
2753 v_uint16 ss[6];
2754 v_expand(s0, ss[0], ss[1]);
2755 v_expand(s1, ss[2], ss[3]);
2756 v_expand(s2, ss[4], ss[5]);
2757 v_int32 vs[12];
2758 for(int k = 0; k < 6; k++)
2759 {
2760 v_expand(v_reinterpret_as_s16(ss[k]), vs[k*2+0], vs[k*2+1]);
2761 }
2762
2763 for(int bufp = 0; bufp < 12; bufp++)
2764 {
2765 v_store_aligned(buf + j + bufp, v_muladd(v_cvt_f32(vs[bufp]), mluv[bufp%3], aluv[bufp%3]));
2766 }
2767 }
2768#endif
2769
2770 for( ; j < dn*3; j += 3 )
2771 {
2772 buf[j] = src[j]*((float)fl);
2773 buf[j+1] = (float)(src[j+1] - 128.f);
2774 buf[j+2] = (float)(src[j+2] - 128.f);
2775 }
2776
2777 fcvt(buf, buf, dn);
2778
2779 j = 0;
2780
2781#if CV_SIMD
2782 static const int nBlock = 4*fsize;
2783 v_float32 v255 = vx_setall_f32(255.f);
2784 if(dcn == 4)
2785 {
2786 v_uint8 valpha = vx_setall_u8(alpha);
2787 for( ; j <= (dn-nBlock)*3;
2788 j += nBlock*3, dst += nBlock)
2789 {
2790 v_float32 vf[4*3];
2791 for(int k = 0; k < 4; k++)
2792 {
2793 v_load_deinterleave(buf + j, vf[k*3+0], vf[k*3+1], vf[k*3+2]);
2794 }
2795
2796 v_int32 vi[4*3];
2797 for(int k = 0; k < 4*3; k++)
2798 {
2799 vi[k] = v_round(v_mul(vf[k], v255));
2800 }
2801
2802 v_uint8 rgb[3];
2803 for(int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
2804 {
2805 rgb[k] = v_pack_u(v_pack(vi[0*3+k], vi[1*3+k]),
2806 v_pack(vi[2*3+k], vi[3*3+k]));
2807 }
2808
2809 v_store_interleave(dst, rgb[0], rgb[1], rgb[2], valpha);
2810 }
2811 }
2812 else // dcn == 3
2813 {
2814 for(; j < dn*3 - nBlock; j += nBlock, dst += nBlock)
2815 {
2816 v_float32 vf[4];
2817 v_int32 vi[4];
2818 for(int k = 0; k < 4; k++)
2819 {
2820 vf[k] = vx_load_aligned(buf + j + k*fsize);
2821 vi[k] = v_round(v_mul(vf[k], v255));
2822 }
2823 v_store(dst, v_pack_u(v_pack(vi[0], vi[1]), v_pack(vi[2], vi[3])));
2824 }
2825 }
2826#endif
2827
2828 for( ; j < dn*3; j += 3, dst += dcn )
2829 {
2830 dst[0] = saturate_cast<uchar>(buf[j]*255.f);
2831 dst[1] = saturate_cast<uchar>(buf[j+1]*255.f);
2832 dst[2] = saturate_cast<uchar>(buf[j+2]*255.f);
2833 if( dcn == 4 )
2834 dst[3] = alpha;
2835 }
2836 }
2837 }
2838
2839 Lab2RGBfloat fcvt;
2840 Lab2RGBinteger icvt;
2841 int dstcn;
2842};

2846struct RGB2Luvfloat
2847{
2848 typedef float channel_type;
2849
2850 RGB2Luvfloat( int _srccn, int blueIdx, const float* _coeffs,
2851 const float* whitept, bool _srgb )
2852 : srccn(_srccn), srgb(_srgb)
2853 {
2854 initLabTabs();
2855
2856 softdouble whitePt[3];
2857 for(int i = 0; i < 3; i++ )
2858 if(whitept)
2859 whitePt[i] = softdouble(whitept[i]);
2860 else
2861 whitePt[i] = D65[i];
2862
2863 for(int i = 0; i < 3; i++ )
2864 {
2865 for(int j = 0; j < 3; j++)
2866 if(_coeffs)
2867 coeffs[i*3+j] = _coeffs[i*3+j];
2868 else
2869 coeffs[i*3+j] = (float)(sRGB2XYZ_D65[i*3+j]);
2870
2871 if( blueIdx == 0 )
2872 std::swap(coeffs[i*3], coeffs[i*3+2]);
2873 CV_Assert( coeffs[i*3] >= 0 && coeffs[i*3+1] >= 0 && coeffs[i*3+2] >= 0 &&
2874 softfloat(coeffs[i*3]) +
2875 softfloat(coeffs[i*3+1]) +
2876 softfloat(coeffs[i*3+2]) < softfloat(1.5f) );
2877 }
2878
2879 softfloat d = whitePt[0] +
2880 whitePt[1]*softdouble(15) +
2881 whitePt[2]*softdouble(3);
2882 d = softfloat::one()/max(d, softfloat::eps());
2883 un = d*softfloat(13*4)*whitePt[0];
2884 vn = d*softfloat(13*9)*whitePt[1];
2885
2886 CV_Assert(whitePt[1] == softdouble::one());
2887 }
2888
2889 void operator()(const float* src, float* dst, int n) const
2890 {
2891 CV_INSTRUMENT_REGION();
2892
2893 int i = 0, scn = srccn;
2894 float gscale = GammaTabScale;
2895 const float* gammaTab = srgb ? sRGBGammaTab : 0;
2896 float C0 = coeffs[0], C1 = coeffs[1], C2 = coeffs[2],
2897 C3 = coeffs[3], C4 = coeffs[4], C5 = coeffs[5],
2898 C6 = coeffs[6], C7 = coeffs[7], C8 = coeffs[8];
2899
2900#if CV_SIMD
2901 const int vsize = VTraits<v_float32>::vlanes();
2902 const int nrepeats = VTraits<v_float32>::nlanes == 4 ? 2 : 1;
2903 for( ; i <= n-vsize*nrepeats;
2904 i+= vsize*nrepeats, src += scn*vsize*nrepeats, dst += 3*vsize*nrepeats)
2905 {
2906 v_float32 R[nrepeats], G[nrepeats], B[nrepeats], A;
2907 if(scn == 4)
2908 {
2909 for (int k = 0; k < nrepeats; k++)
2910 {
2911 v_load_deinterleave(src + k*4*vsize, R[k], G[k], B[k], A);
2912 }
2913 }
2914 else // scn == 3
2915 {
2916 for (int k = 0; k < nrepeats; k++)
2917 {
2918 v_load_deinterleave(src + k*3*vsize, R[k], G[k], B[k]);
2919 }
2920 }
2921
2922 v_float32 zero = vx_setzero_f32(), one = vx_setall_f32(1.f);
2923 for (int k = 0; k < nrepeats; k++)
2924 {
2925 R[k] = v_min(v_max(R[k], zero), one);
2926 G[k] = v_min(v_max(G[k], zero), one);
2927 B[k] = v_min(v_max(B[k], zero), one);
2928 }
2929
2930 if(gammaTab)
2931 {
2932 v_float32 vgscale = vx_setall_f32(gscale);
2933 for (int k = 0; k < nrepeats; k++)
2934 {
2935 R[k] = v_mul(R[k], vgscale);
2936 G[k] = v_mul(G[k], vgscale);
2937 B[k] = v_mul(B[k], vgscale);
2938 }
2939
2940 for (int k = 0; k < nrepeats; k++)
2941 {
2942 R[k] = splineInterpolate(R[k], gammaTab, GAMMA_TAB_SIZE);
2943 G[k] = splineInterpolate(G[k], gammaTab, GAMMA_TAB_SIZE);
2944 B[k] = splineInterpolate(B[k], gammaTab, GAMMA_TAB_SIZE);
2945 }
2946 }
2947
2948 v_float32 X[nrepeats], Y[nrepeats], Z[nrepeats];
2949 v_float32 vc0 = vx_setall_f32(C0), vc1 = vx_setall_f32(C1), vc2 = vx_setall_f32(C2);
2950 v_float32 vc3 = vx_setall_f32(C3), vc4 = vx_setall_f32(C4), vc5 = vx_setall_f32(C5);
2951 v_float32 vc6 = vx_setall_f32(C6), vc7 = vx_setall_f32(C7), vc8 = vx_setall_f32(C8);
2952 for (int k = 0; k < nrepeats; k++)
2953 {
2954 X[k] = v_fma(R[k], vc0, v_fma(G[k], vc1, v_mul(B[k], vc2)));
2955 Y[k] = v_fma(R[k], vc3, v_fma(G[k], vc4, v_mul(B[k], vc5)));
2956 Z[k] = v_fma(R[k], vc6, v_fma(G[k], vc7, v_mul(B[k], vc8)));
2957 }
2958
2959 v_float32 L[nrepeats], u[nrepeats], v[nrepeats];
2960 v_float32 vmun = vx_setall_f32(-un), vmvn = vx_setall_f32(-vn);
2961 for (int k = 0; k < nrepeats; k++)
2962 {
2963 L[k] = splineInterpolate(v_mul(Y[k], vx_setall_f32(LabCbrtTabScale)), LabCbrtTab, LAB_CBRT_TAB_SIZE);
2964 // L = 116.f*L - 16.f;
2965 L[k] = v_fma(L[k], vx_setall_f32(116.f), vx_setall_f32(-16.f));
2966
2967 v_float32 d;
2968 // d = (4*13) / max(X + 15 * Y + 3 * Z, FLT_EPSILON)
2969 d = v_fma(Y[k], vx_setall_f32(15.f), v_fma(Z[k], vx_setall_f32(3.f), X[k]));
2970 d = v_div(vx_setall_f32(4.F * 13.F), v_max(d, vx_setall_f32(FLT_EPSILON)));
2971 // u = L*(X*d - un)
2972 u[k] = v_mul(L[k], v_fma(X[k], d, vmun));
2973 // v = L*((9*0.25f)*Y*d - vn);
2974 v[k] = v_mul(L[k], v_fma(v_mul(vx_setall_f32(9.F * 0.25F), Y[k]), d, vmvn));
2975 }
2976
2977 for (int k = 0; k < nrepeats; k++)
2978 {
2979 v_store_interleave(dst + k*3*vsize, L[k], u[k], v[k]);
2980 }
2981 }
2982#endif
2983
2984 for( ; i < n; i++, src += scn, dst += 3 )
2985 {
2986 float R = src[0], G = src[1], B = src[2];
2987 R = clip(R);
2988 G = clip(G);
2989 B = clip(B);
2990 if( gammaTab )
2991 {
2992 R = splineInterpolate(R*gscale, gammaTab, GAMMA_TAB_SIZE);
2993 G = splineInterpolate(G*gscale, gammaTab, GAMMA_TAB_SIZE);
2994 B = splineInterpolate(B*gscale, gammaTab, GAMMA_TAB_SIZE);
2995 }
2996
2997 float X = R*C0 + G*C1 + B*C2;
2998 float Y = R*C3 + G*C4 + B*C5;
2999 float Z = R*C6 + G*C7 + B*C8;
3000
3001 float L = splineInterpolate(Y*LabCbrtTabScale, LabCbrtTab, LAB_CBRT_TAB_SIZE);
3002 L = 116.f*L - 16.f;
3003
3004 float d = (4*13) / std::max(X + 15 * Y + 3 * Z, FLT_EPSILON);
3005 float u = L*(X*d - un);
3006 float v = L*((9*0.25f)*Y*d - vn);
3007
3008 dst[0] = L; dst[1] = u; dst[2] = v;
3009 }
3010 }
3011
3012 int srccn;
3013 float coeffs[9], un, vn;
3014 bool srgb;
3015};

3020
3021 RGB2Luv_f( int _srccn, int blueIdx, const float* _coeffs,

3023 : fcvt(_srccn, blueIdx, _coeffs, whitept, _srgb), srccn(_srccn)

3035struct Luv2RGBfloat
3036{
3037 typedef float channel_type;
3038
3039 Luv2RGBfloat( int _dstcn, int blueIdx, const float* _coeffs,
3040 const float* whitept, bool _srgb )
3041 : dstcn(_dstcn), srgb(_srgb)
3042 {
3043 initLabTabs();
3044
3045 softdouble whitePt[3];
3046 for(int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
3047 if(whitept)
3048 whitePt[i] = softdouble(whitept[i]);
3049 else
3050 whitePt[i] = D65[i];
3051
3052 for( int i = 0; i < 3; i++ )
3053 {
3054 softfloat c[3];
3055 for(int j = 0; j < 3; j++)
3056 if(_coeffs)
3057 c[j] = softfloat(_coeffs[i+j*3]);
3058 else
3059 c[j] = XYZ2sRGB_D65[i+j*3];
3060
3061 coeffs[i+(blueIdx^2)*3] = c[0];
3062 coeffs[i+3] = c[1];
3063 coeffs[i+blueIdx*3] = c[2];
3064 }
3065
3066 softfloat d = whitePt[0] +
3067 whitePt[1]*softdouble(15) +
3068 whitePt[2]*softdouble(3);
3069 d = softfloat::one()/max(d, softfloat::eps());
3070 un = softfloat(4*13)*d*whitePt[0];
3071 vn = softfloat(9*13)*d*whitePt[1];
3072
3073 CV_Assert(whitePt[1] == softdouble::one());
3074 }
3075
3076 void operator()(const float* src, float* dst, int n) const
3077 {
3078 CV_INSTRUMENT_REGION();
3079
3080 int i = 0, dcn = dstcn;
3081 const float* gammaTab = srgb ? sRGBInvGammaTab : 0;
3082 float gscale = GammaTabScale;
3083 float C0 = coeffs[0], C1 = coeffs[1], C2 = coeffs[2],
3084 C3 = coeffs[3], C4 = coeffs[4], C5 = coeffs[5],
3085 C6 = coeffs[6], C7 = coeffs[7], C8 = coeffs[8];
3086 float alpha = ColorChannel<float>::max();
3087 float _un = un, _vn = vn;
3088
3089#if CV_SIMD
3090 const int vsize = VTraits<v_float32>::vlanes();
3091 const int nrepeats = VTraits<v_float32>::nlanes == 4 ? 2 : 1;
3092 for( ; i <= n - vsize*nrepeats;
3093 i += vsize*nrepeats, src += vsize*3*nrepeats, dst += dcn*vsize*nrepeats)
3094 {
3095 v_float32 L[nrepeats], u[nrepeats], v[nrepeats];
3096 for (int k = 0; k < nrepeats; k++)
3097 {
3098 v_load_deinterleave(src + k*vsize*3, L[k], u[k], v[k]);
3099 }
3100
3101 v_float32 X[nrepeats], Y[nrepeats], Z[nrepeats];
3102
3103 v_float32 v16 = vx_setall_f32(16.f);
3104 v_float32 v116inv = vx_setall_f32(1.f/116.f);
3105 v_float32 v903inv = vx_setall_f32(1.0f/903.296296f); //(3./29.)^3
3106 for (int k = 0; k < nrepeats; k++)
3107 {
3108 v_float32 Ylo, Yhi;
3109
3110 // ((L + 16)/116)^3
3111 Ylo = v_mul(v_add(L[k], v16), v116inv);
3112 Ylo = v_mul(v_mul(Ylo, Ylo), Ylo);
3113 // L*(3./29.)^3
3114 Yhi = v_mul(L[k], v903inv);
3115
3116 // Y = (L <= 8) ? Y0 : Y1;
3117 Y[k] = v_select(v_ge(L[k], vx_setall_f32(8.f)), Ylo, Yhi);
3118 }
3119
3120 v_float32 v4inv = vx_setall_f32(0.25f), v3 = vx_setall_f32(3.f);
3121 for(int k = 0; k < nrepeats; k++)
3122 {
3123 v_float32 up, vp;
3124
3125 // up = 3*(u + L*_un);
3126 up = v_mul(v3, v_fma(L[k], vx_setall_f32(_un), u[k]));
3127 // vp = 0.25/(v + L*_vn);
3128 vp = v_div(v4inv, v_fma(L[k], vx_setall_f32(_vn), v[k]));
3129
3130 // vp = max(-0.25, min(0.25, vp));
3131 vp = v_max(vx_setall_f32(-0.25f), v_min(v4inv, vp));
3132
3133 //X = 3*up*vp; // (*Y) is done later
3134 X[k] = v_mul(v_mul(v3, up), vp);
3135 //Z = ((12*13*L - up)*vp - 5); // (*Y) is done later
3136 // xor flips the sign, works like unary minus
3137 Z[k] = v_fma(v_fma(L[k], vx_setall_f32(12.f*13.f), (v_xor(vx_setall_f32(-0.F), up))), vp, vx_setall_f32(-5.f));
3138 }
3139
3140 v_float32 R[nrepeats], G[nrepeats], B[nrepeats];
3141 v_float32 vc0 = vx_setall_f32(C0), vc1 = vx_setall_f32(C1), vc2 = vx_setall_f32(C2);
3142 v_float32 vc3 = vx_setall_f32(C3), vc4 = vx_setall_f32(C4), vc5 = vx_setall_f32(C5);
3143 v_float32 vc6 = vx_setall_f32(C6), vc7 = vx_setall_f32(C7), vc8 = vx_setall_f32(C8);
3144 for(int k = 0; k < nrepeats; k++)
3145 {
3146 // R = (X*C0 + C1 + Z*C2)*Y; // here (*Y) is done
3147 R[k] = v_mul(v_fma(Z[k], vc2, v_fma(X[k], vc0, vc1)), Y[k]);
3148 G[k] = v_mul(v_fma(Z[k], vc5, v_fma(X[k], vc3, vc4)), Y[k]);
3149 B[k] = v_mul(v_fma(Z[k], vc8, v_fma(X[k], vc6, vc7)), Y[k]);
3150 }
3151
3152 v_float32 vzero = vx_setzero_f32(), v1 = vx_setall_f32(1.f);
3153 for(int k = 0; k < nrepeats; k++)
3154 {
3155 R[k] = v_min(v_max(R[k], vzero), v1);
3156 G[k] = v_min(v_max(G[k], vzero), v1);
3157 B[k] = v_min(v_max(B[k], vzero), v1);
3158 }
3159
3160 if(gammaTab)
3161 {
3162 v_float32 vgscale = vx_setall_f32(gscale);
3163 for(int k = 0; k < nrepeats; k++)
3164 {
3165 R[k] = v_mul(R[k], vgscale);
3166 G[k] = v_mul(G[k], vgscale);
3167 B[k] = v_mul(B[k], vgscale);
3168 }
3169 for(int k = 0; k < nrepeats; k++)
3170 {
3171 R[k] = splineInterpolate(R[k], gammaTab, GAMMA_TAB_SIZE);
3172 G[k] = splineInterpolate(G[k], gammaTab, GAMMA_TAB_SIZE);
3173 B[k] = splineInterpolate(B[k], gammaTab, GAMMA_TAB_SIZE);
3174 }
3175 }
3176 for(int k = 0; k < nrepeats; k++)
3177 {
3178 if(dcn == 4)
3179 {
3180 v_store_interleave(dst + k*vsize*4, R[k], G[k], B[k], vx_setall_f32(alpha));
3181 }
3182 else // dcn == 3
3183 {
3184 v_store_interleave(dst + k*vsize*3, R[k], G[k], B[k]);
3185 }
3186 }
3187 }
3188#endif
3189
3190 for( ; i < n; i++, src += 3, dst += dcn )
3191 {
3192 float L = src[0], u = src[1], v = src[2], X, Y, Z;
3193 if(L >= 8)
3194 {
3195 Y = (L + 16.f) * (1.f/116.f);
3196 Y = Y*Y*Y;
3197 }
3198 else
3199 {
3200 Y = L * (1.0f/903.3f); // L*(3./29.)^3
3201 }
3202 float up = 3.f*(u + L*_un);
3203 float vp = 0.25f/(v + L*_vn);
3204 if(vp > 0.25f) vp = 0.25f;
3205 if(vp < -0.25f) vp = -0.25f;
3206 X = Y*3.f*up*vp;
3207 Z = Y*(((12.f*13.f)*L - up)*vp - 5.f);
3208
3209 float R = X*C0 + Y*C1 + Z*C2;
3210 float G = X*C3 + Y*C4 + Z*C5;
3211 float B = X*C6 + Y*C7 + Z*C8;
3212
3213 R = clip(R);
3214 G = clip(G);
3215 B = clip(B);
3216
3217 if( gammaTab )
3218 {
3219 R = splineInterpolate(R*gscale, gammaTab, GAMMA_TAB_SIZE);
3220 G = splineInterpolate(G*gscale, gammaTab, GAMMA_TAB_SIZE);
3221 B = splineInterpolate(B*gscale, gammaTab, GAMMA_TAB_SIZE);
3222 }
3223
3224 dst[0] = R; dst[1] = G; dst[2] = B;
3225 if( dcn == 4 )
3226 dst[3] = alpha;
3227 }
3228 }
3229
3230 int dstcn;
3231 float coeffs[9], un, vn;
3232 bool srgb;
3233};

3240 Luv2RGB_f( int _dstcn, int blueIdx, const float* _coeffs,

3242 : fcvt(_dstcn, blueIdx, _coeffs, whitept, _srgb), dstcn(_dstcn)
3243 { }

3245 void operator()(const float* src, float* dst, int n) const
3246 {
3247 fcvt(src, dst, n);
3248 }
3249
3250 Luv2RGBfloat fcvt;

3253
3254struct RGB2Luvinterpolate
3255{
3256 typedef uchar channel_type;
3257
3258 RGB2Luvinterpolate( int _srccn, int _blueIdx, const float* /* _coeffs */,
3259 const float* /* _whitept */, bool /*_srgb*/ )
3260 : srccn(_srccn), blueIdx(_blueIdx)
3261 {
3262 initLabTabs();
3263 }
3264
3265 void operator()(const uchar* src, uchar* dst, int n) const
3266 {
3267 CV_INSTRUMENT_REGION();
3268
3269 int i, scn = srccn, bIdx = blueIdx;
3270
3271 i = 0; n *= 3;
3272
3273#if CV_SIMD
3274 if(enablePackedRGB2Luv)
3275 {
3276 const int vsize = VTraits<v_uint16>::vlanes();
3277 static const int nPixels = vsize*2;
3278 for(; i <= n - 3*nPixels; i += 3*nPixels, src += scn*nPixels)
3279 {
3280 /*
3281 int R = src[bIdx], G = src[1], B = src[bIdx^2];
3282 */
3283 v_uint8 r, g, b, dummy;
3284 if(scn == 3)
3285 {
3286 v_load_deinterleave(src, r, g, b);
3287 }
3288 else // scn == 4
3289 {
3290 v_load_deinterleave(src, r, g, b, dummy);
3291 }
3292
3293 if(bIdx)
3294 {
3295 swap(r, b);
3296 }
3297
3298 /*
3299 static const int baseDiv = LAB_BASE/256;
3300 R = R*baseDiv, G = G*baseDiv, B = B*baseDiv;
3301 */
3302 v_uint16 r0, r1, g0, g1, b0, b1;
3303 v_expand(r, r0, r1);
3304 v_expand(g, g0, g1);
3305 v_expand(b, b0, b1);
3306 r0 = v_shl<lab_base_shift - 8>(r0); r1 = v_shl<lab_base_shift - 8>(r1);
3307 g0 = v_shl<lab_base_shift - 8>(g0); g1 = v_shl<lab_base_shift - 8>(g1);
3308 b0 = v_shl<lab_base_shift - 8>(b0); b1 = v_shl<lab_base_shift - 8>(b1);
3309
3310 /*
3311 int L, u, v;
3312 trilinearInterpolate(R, G, B, RGB2LuvLUT_s16, L, u, v);
3313 */
3314 v_uint16 l0, u0, v0, l1, u1, v1;
3315 trilinearPackedInterpolate(r0, g0, b0, LABLUVLUTs16.RGB2LuvLUT_s16, l0, u0, v0);
3316 trilinearPackedInterpolate(r1, g1, b1, LABLUVLUTs16.RGB2LuvLUT_s16, l1, u1, v1);
3317
3318 /*
3319 dst[i] = saturate_cast<uchar>(L/baseDiv);
3320 dst[i+1] = saturate_cast<uchar>(u/baseDiv);
3321 dst[i+2] = saturate_cast<uchar>(v/baseDiv);
3322 */
3323 l0 = v_shr<lab_base_shift - 8>(l0); l1 = v_shr<lab_base_shift - 8>(l1);
3324 u0 = v_shr<lab_base_shift - 8>(u0); u1 = v_shr<lab_base_shift - 8>(u1);
3325 v0 = v_shr<lab_base_shift - 8>(v0); v1 = v_shr<lab_base_shift - 8>(v1);
3326 v_uint8 l = v_pack(l0, l1);
3327 v_uint8 u = v_pack(u0, u1);
3328 v_uint8 v = v_pack(v0, v1);
3329 v_store_interleave(dst + i, l, u, v);
3330 }
3331 }
3332#endif // CV_SIMD
3333
3334 for(; i < n; i += 3, src += scn)
3335 {
3336 int R = src[bIdx], G = src[1], B = src[bIdx^2];
3337
3338 // (LAB_BASE/255) gives more accuracy but not very much
3339 static const int baseDiv = LAB_BASE/256;
3340 R = R*baseDiv, G = G*baseDiv, B = B*baseDiv;
3341
3342 int L, u, v;
3343 trilinearInterpolate(R, G, B, LABLUVLUTs16.RGB2LuvLUT_s16, L, u, v);
3344
3345 dst[i] = saturate_cast<uchar>(L/baseDiv);
3346 dst[i+1] = saturate_cast<uchar>(u/baseDiv);
3347 dst[i+2] = saturate_cast<uchar>(v/baseDiv);
3348 }
3349 }
3350
3351 int srccn;
3352 int blueIdx;
3353};
3354
3355
3356struct RGB2Luv_b
3357{
3358 typedef uchar channel_type;
3359 static const int bufChannels = 3;
3360
3361 RGB2Luv_b( int _srccn, int blueIdx, const float* _coeffs,
3362 const float* _whitept, bool _srgb )
3363 : srccn(_srccn),
3364 fcvt(bufChannels, blueIdx, _coeffs, _whitept, _srgb),
3365 icvt(_srccn, blueIdx, _coeffs, _whitept, _srgb)
3366 {
3367 // using interpolation for LRGB gives error up to 8 of 255, don't use it
3368 useInterpolation = (!_coeffs && !_whitept && _srgb
3369 && enableBitExactness
3370 && enableRGB2LuvInterpolation);
3371 }
3372
3373 void operator()(const uchar* src, uchar* dst, int n) const
3374 {
3375 CV_INSTRUMENT_REGION();
3376
3377 if(useInterpolation)
3378 {
3379 icvt(src, dst, n);
3380 return;
3381 }
3382
3383 int scn = srccn;
3384#if CV_SIMD
3385 float CV_DECL_ALIGNED(CV_SIMD_WIDTH) buf[bufChannels*BLOCK_SIZE];
3386#else
3387 float CV_DECL_ALIGNED(16) buf[bufChannels*BLOCK_SIZE];
3388#endif
3389
3390 static const softfloat fL = f255/softfloat(100);
3391 static const softfloat fu = f255/uRange;
3392 static const softfloat fv = f255/vRange;
3393 static const softfloat su = -uLow*f255/uRange;
3394 static const softfloat sv = -vLow*f255/vRange;
3395#if CV_SIMD
3396 const int fsize = VTraits<v_float32>::vlanes();
3397 v_float32 ml = vx_setall_f32((float)fL), al = vx_setzero_f32();
3398 v_float32 mu = vx_setall_f32((float)fu), au = vx_setall_f32((float)su);
3399 v_float32 mv = vx_setall_f32((float)fv), av = vx_setall_f32((float)sv);
3400 //TODO: fix that when v_interleave is available
3401 float CV_DECL_ALIGNED(CV_SIMD_WIDTH) interTmpM[VTraits<v_float32>::max_nlanes*3], interTmpA[VTraits<v_float32>::max_nlanes*3];
3402 v_store_interleave(interTmpM, ml, mu, mv);
3403 v_store_interleave(interTmpA, al, au, av);
3404 v_float32 mluv[3], aluv[3];
3405 for(int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
3406 {
3407 mluv[k] = vx_load_aligned(interTmpM + k*fsize);
3408 aluv[k] = vx_load_aligned(interTmpA + k*fsize);
3409 }
3410#endif
3411
3412 for(int i = 0; i < n; i += BLOCK_SIZE, dst += BLOCK_SIZE*bufChannels )
3413 {
3414 int dn = std::min(n - i, (int)BLOCK_SIZE);
3415
3416 static const softfloat f255inv = softfloat::one()/f255;
3417#if CV_SIMD
3418 v_float32 v255inv = vx_setall_f32((float)f255inv);
3419 if(scn == 4)
3420 {
3421 int j = 0;
3422 static const int nBlock = fsize*4;
3423 for( ; j <= dn*bufChannels - nBlock*3;
3424 j += nBlock*3, src += nBlock*4)
3425 {
3426 v_uint8 rgb[3], dummy;
3427 v_load_deinterleave(src, rgb[0], rgb[1], rgb[2], dummy);
3428
3429 v_uint16 d[3*2];
3430 for(int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
3431 {
3432 v_expand(rgb[k], d[k*2+0], d[k*2+1]);
3433 }
3434 v_int32 q[3*4];
3435 for(int k = 0; k < 3*2; k++)
3436 {
3437 v_expand(v_reinterpret_as_s16(d[k]), q[k*2+0], q[k*2+1]);
3438 }
3439
3440 v_float32 f[3*4];
3441 for(int k = 0; k < 3*4; k++)
3442 {
3443 f[k] = v_mul(v_cvt_f32(q[k]), v255inv);
3444 }
3445
3446 for(int k = 0; k < 4; k++)
3447 {
3448 v_store_interleave(buf + j + k*3*fsize, f[0*4+k], f[1*4+k], f[2*4+k]);
3449 }
3450 }
3451 for( ; j < dn*bufChannels; j += bufChannels, src += 4 )
3452 {
3453 buf[j ] = (float)(src[0]*((float)f255inv));
3454 buf[j+1] = (float)(src[1]*((float)f255inv));
3455 buf[j+2] = (float)(src[2]*((float)f255inv));
3456 }
3457 }
3458 else // scn == 3
3459 {
3460 int j = 0;
3461 static const int nBlock = fsize*2;
3462 for( ; j <= dn*bufChannels - nBlock;
3463 j += nBlock, src += nBlock)
3464 {
3465 v_uint16 d = vx_load_expand(src);
3466 v_int32 q0, q1;
3467 v_expand(v_reinterpret_as_s16(d), q0, q1);
3468
3469 v_store_aligned(buf + j + 0*fsize, v_mul(v_cvt_f32(q0), v255inv));
3470 v_store_aligned(buf + j + 1*fsize, v_mul(v_cvt_f32(q1), v255inv));
3471 }
3472 for( ; j < dn*bufChannels; j++, src++ )
3473 {
3474 buf[j] = (float)(src[0]*((float)f255inv));
3475 }
3476 }
3477#else
3478 for(int j = 0; j < dn*bufChannels; j += bufChannels, src += scn )
3479 {
3480 buf[j ] = (float)(src[0]*((float)f255inv));
3481 buf[j+1] = (float)(src[1]*((float)f255inv));
3482 buf[j+2] = (float)(src[2]*((float)f255inv));
3483 }
3484#endif
3485
3486 fcvt(buf, buf, dn);
3487
3488 int j = 0;
3489
3490#if CV_SIMD
3491 for( ; j <= dn*3 - fsize*3*4; j += fsize*3*4)
3492 {
3493 v_float32 f[3*4];
3494 for(int k = 0; k < 3*4; k++)
3495 f[k] = vx_load_aligned(buf + j + k*fsize);
3496
3497 for(int k = 0; k < 4; k++)
3498 {
3499 f[k*3+0] = v_fma(f[k*3+0], mluv[0], aluv[0]);
3500 f[k*3+1] = v_fma(f[k*3+1], mluv[1], aluv[1]);
3501 f[k*3+2] = v_fma(f[k*3+2], mluv[2], aluv[2]);
3502 }
3503
3504 v_int32 q[3*4];
3505 for(int k = 0; k < 3*4; k++)
3506 {
3507 q[k] = v_round(f[k]);
3508 }
3509
3510 for(int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
3511 {
3512 v_store(dst + j + k*fsize*4, v_pack_u(v_pack(q[k*4+0], q[k*4+1]),
3513 v_pack(q[k*4+2], q[k*4+3])));
3514 }
3515 }
3516#endif
3517 for( ; j < dn*3; j += 3 )
3518 {
3519 dst[j+0] = saturate_cast<uchar>(buf[j+0]*(float)fL);
3520 dst[j+1] = saturate_cast<uchar>(buf[j+1]*(float)fu + (float)su);
3521 dst[j+2] = saturate_cast<uchar>(buf[j+2]*(float)fv + (float)sv);
3522 }
3523 }
3524 }
3525
3526 int srccn;
3527 RGB2Luvfloat fcvt;
3528 RGB2Luvinterpolate icvt;
3529
3530 bool useInterpolation;
3531};
3532
3533
3534struct Luv2RGBinteger
3535{
3536 typedef uchar channel_type;
3537
3538 static const int base_shift = 14;
3539 static const int BASE = (1 << base_shift);
3540 static const int shift = lab_shift+(base_shift-inv_gamma_shift);
3541
3542 // whitept is fixed for int calculations
3543 Luv2RGBinteger( int _dstcn, int blueIdx, const float* _coeffs,
3544 const float* /*_whitept*/, bool _srgb )
3545 : dstcn(_dstcn), issRGB(_srgb)
3546 {
3547 initLabTabs();
3548
3549 static const softdouble lshift(1 << lab_shift);
3550 for(int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
3551 {
3552 softdouble c[3];
3553 for(int j = 0; j < 3; j++)
3554 if(_coeffs)
3555 c[j] = softdouble(_coeffs[i + j*3]);
3556 else
3557 c[j] = XYZ2sRGB_D65[i + j*3];
3558
3559 coeffs[i+blueIdx*3] = cvRound(lshift*c[0]);
3560 coeffs[i+3] = cvRound(lshift*c[1]);
3561 coeffs[i+(blueIdx^2)*3] = cvRound(lshift*c[2]);
3562 }
3563 }
3564
3565 // L, u, v should be in their natural range
3566 inline void process(const uchar LL, const uchar uu, const uchar vv, int& ro, int& go, int& bo) const
3567 {
3568 ushort y = LabToYF_b[LL*2];
3569
3570 // y : [0, BASE]
3571 // up: [-402, 1431.57]*(BASE/1024)
3572 // vp: +/- 0.25*BASE*1024
3573 int up = LUVLUT.LuToUp_b[LL*256+uu];
3574 int vp = LUVLUT.LvToVp_b[LL*256+vv];
3575 // X = y*3.f* up/((float)BASE/1024) *vp/((float)BASE*1024);
3576 // Z = y*(((12.f*13.f)*((float)LL)*100.f/255.f - up/((float)BASE))*vp/((float)BASE*1024) - 5.f);
3577
3578 long long int xv = ((int)up)*(long long)vp;
3579 int x = (int)(xv/BASE);
3580 x = (int)(((long long int)y)*x/BASE);
3581
3582 long long int vpl = LUVLUT.LvToVpl_b[LL*256+vv];
3583 long long int zp = vpl - xv*(255/3);
3584 zp /= BASE;
3585 long long int zq = zp - (long long)(5*255*BASE);
3586 int zm = (int)(y*zq/BASE);
3587 int z = zm/256 + zm/65536;
3588
3589 //limit X, Y, Z to [0, 2] to fit white point
3590 x = max(0, min(2*BASE, x)); z = max(0, min(2*BASE, z));
3591
3592 int C0 = coeffs[0], C1 = coeffs[1], C2 = coeffs[2];
3593 int C3 = coeffs[3], C4 = coeffs[4], C5 = coeffs[5];
3594 int C6 = coeffs[6], C7 = coeffs[7], C8 = coeffs[8];
3595
3596 ro = CV_DESCALE(C0 * x + C1 * y + C2 * z, shift);
3597 go = CV_DESCALE(C3 * x + C4 * y + C5 * z, shift);
3598 bo = CV_DESCALE(C6 * x + C7 * y + C8 * z, shift);
3599
3600 ro = max(0, min((int)INV_GAMMA_TAB_SIZE-1, ro));
3601 go = max(0, min((int)INV_GAMMA_TAB_SIZE-1, go));
3602 bo = max(0, min((int)INV_GAMMA_TAB_SIZE-1, bo));
3603
3604 if(issRGB)
3605 {
3606 ushort* tab = sRGBInvGammaTab_b;
3607 ro = tab[ro];
3608 go = tab[go];
3609 bo = tab[bo];
3610 }
3611 else
3612 {
3613 // rgb = (rgb*255) >> inv_gamma_shift
3614 ro = ((ro << 8) - ro) >> inv_gamma_shift;
3615 go = ((go << 8) - go) >> inv_gamma_shift;
3616 bo = ((bo << 8) - bo) >> inv_gamma_shift;
3617 }
3618 }
3619
3620#if CV_SIMD
3621 inline void processLuvToXYZ(const v_uint8& lv, const v_uint8& uv, const v_uint8& vv,
3622 v_int32 (&x)[4], v_int32 (&y)[4], v_int32 (&z)[4]) const
3623 {
3624 const int vsize = VTraits<v_uint8>::vlanes();
3625 const int vsize_max = VTraits<v_uint8>::max_nlanes;
3626
3627 v_uint16 lv0, lv1;
3628 v_expand(lv, lv0, lv1);
3629 v_uint32 lq[4];
3630 v_expand(lv0, lq[0], lq[1]);
3631 v_expand(lv1, lq[2], lq[3]);
3632
3633 // y = LabToYF_b[LL*2];
3634 // load int32 instead of int16 then cut unused part by masking
3635 v_int32 mask16 = vx_setall_s32(0xFFFF);
3636 for(int k = 0; k < 4; k++)
3637 {
3638 y[k] = v_and(v_lut((const int *)LabToYF_b, v_reinterpret_as_s32(lq[k])), mask16);
3639 }
3640
3641 v_int32 up[4], vp[4];
3642 // int up = LUVLUT.LuToUp_b[LL*256+u];
3643 // int vp = LUVLUT.LvToVp_b[LL*256+v];
3644 v_uint16 uv0, uv1, vv0, vv1;
3645 v_expand(uv, uv0, uv1);
3646 v_expand(vv, vv0, vv1);
3647 // LL*256
3648 v_uint16 ll0, ll1;
3649 ll0 = v_shl<8>(lv0); ll1 = v_shl<8>(lv1);
3650 v_uint16 upidx0, upidx1, vpidx0, vpidx1;
3651 upidx0 = v_add(ll0, uv0); upidx1 = v_add(ll1, uv1);
3652 vpidx0 = v_add(ll0, vv0); vpidx1 = v_add(ll1, vv1);
3653 v_uint32 upidx[4], vpidx[4];
3654 v_expand(upidx0, upidx[0], upidx[1]); v_expand(upidx1, upidx[2], upidx[3]);
3655 v_expand(vpidx0, vpidx[0], vpidx[1]); v_expand(vpidx1, vpidx[2], vpidx[3]);
3656 for(int k = 0; k < 4; k++)
3657 {
3658 up[k] = v_lut(LUVLUT.LuToUp_b, v_reinterpret_as_s32(upidx[k]));
3659 vp[k] = v_lut(LUVLUT.LvToVp_b, v_reinterpret_as_s32(vpidx[k]));
3660 }
3661
3662 // long long int vpl = LUVLUT.LvToVpl_b[LL*256+v];
3663 v_int64 vpl[8];
3664 int32_t CV_DECL_ALIGNED(CV_SIMD_WIDTH) vpidxstore[vsize_max];
3665 for(int k = 0; k < 4; k++)
3666 {
3667 v_store_aligned(vpidxstore + k*vsize/4, v_reinterpret_as_s32(vpidx[k]));
3668 }
3669 for(int k = 0; k < 8; k++)
3670 {
3671 vpl[k] = vx_lut((const int64_t*)LUVLUT.LvToVpl_b, vpidxstore + k*vsize/8);
3672 }
3673
3674 // not all 64-bit arithmetic is available in univ. intrinsics
3675 // need to handle it with scalar code
3676 int64_t CV_DECL_ALIGNED(CV_SIMD_WIDTH) vvpl[vsize_max];
3677 for(int k = 0; k < 8; k++)
3678 {
3679 v_store_aligned(vvpl + k*vsize/8, vpl[k]);
3680 }
3681 int32_t CV_DECL_ALIGNED(CV_SIMD_WIDTH) vup[vsize_max], vvp[vsize_max],
3682 vx[vsize_max], vy[vsize_max], vzm[vsize_max];
3683 for(int k = 0; k < 4; k++)
3684 {
3685 v_store_aligned(vup + k*vsize/4, up[k]);
3686 v_store_aligned(vvp + k*vsize/4, vp[k]);
3687 v_store_aligned(vy + k*vsize/4, y[k]);
3688 }
3689 for(int i = 0; i < vsize; i++)
3690 {
3691 int32_t y_ = vy[i];
3692 int32_t up_ = vup[i];
3693 int32_t vp_ = vvp[i];
3694
3695 int64_t vpl_ = vvpl[i];
3696 int64_t xv = up_*(int64_t)vp_;
3697
3698 int64_t zp = vpl_ - xv*(255/3);
3699 zp = zp >> base_shift;
3700 int64_t zq = zp - (5*255*BASE);
3701 int32_t zm = (int32_t)((y_*zq) >> base_shift);
3702 vzm[i] = zm;
3703
3704 vx[i] = (int32_t)(xv >> base_shift);
3705 vx[i] = (int32_t)((((int64_t)y_)*vx[i]) >> base_shift);
3706 }
3707 v_int32 zm[4];
3708 for(int k = 0; k < 4; k++)
3709 {
3710 x[k] = vx_load_aligned(vx + k*vsize/4);
3711 zm[k] = vx_load_aligned(vzm + k*vsize/4);
3712 }
3713
3714 // z = zm/256 + zm/65536;
3715 for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++)
3716 {
3717 z[k] = v_add(v_shr<8>(zm[k]), v_shr<16>(zm[k]));
3718 }
3719
3720 // (x, z) = clip((x, z), min=0, max=2*BASE)
3721 v_int32 zero = vx_setzero_s32(), base2 = vx_setall_s32(2*BASE);
3722 for(int k = 0; k < 4; k++)
3723 {
3724 x[k] = v_max(zero, v_min(base2, x[k]));
3725 z[k] = v_max(zero, v_min(base2, z[k]));
3726 }
3727 }
3728#endif
3729
3730 void operator()(const uchar* src, uchar* dst, int n) const
3731 {
3732 CV_INSTRUMENT_REGION();
3733
3734 int i, dcn = dstcn;
3735 uchar alpha = ColorChannel<uchar>::max();
3736
3737 i = 0;
3738
3739#if CV_SIMD
3740 if(enablePackedLuv2RGB)
3741 {
3742 ushort* tab = sRGBInvGammaTab_b;
3743 bool srgb = issRGB;
3744 static const int vsize = VTraits<v_uint8>::vlanes();
3745 const int descaleShift = 1 << (shift-1);
3746 v_int16 vdescale = vx_setall_s16(descaleShift);
3747 v_int16 vc[9];
3748 for(int k = 0; k < 9; k++)
3749 {
3750 vc[k] = vx_setall_s16((short)coeffs[k]);
3751 }
3752 v_int16 one = vx_setall_s16(1);
3753 v_int16 cbxy, cbz1, cgxy, cgz1, crxy, crz1;
3754 v_int16 dummy;
3755 v_zip(vc[0], vc[1], crxy, dummy);
3756 v_zip(vc[2], one, crz1, dummy);
3757 v_zip(vc[3], vc[4], cgxy, dummy);
3758 v_zip(vc[5], one, cgz1, dummy);
3759 v_zip(vc[6], vc[7], cbxy, dummy);
3760 v_zip(vc[8], one, cbz1, dummy);
3761 // fixing 16bit signed multiplication
3762 // by subtracting 2^(base_shift-1) and then adding result back
3763 v_int32 dummy32, fm[3];
3764 v_expand(v_add(vc[0],vc[1],vc[2]), fm[0], dummy32);
3765 v_expand(v_add(vc[3],vc[4],vc[5]), fm[1], dummy32);
3766 v_expand(v_add(vc[6],vc[7],vc[8]), fm[2], dummy32);
3767 fm[0] = v_shl(fm[0], (base_shift-1));
3768 fm[1] = v_shl(fm[1], (base_shift-1));
3769 fm[2] = v_shl(fm[2], (base_shift-1));
3770
3771 for (; i <= n-vsize; i += vsize, src += 3*vsize, dst += dcn*vsize)
3772 {
3773 v_uint8 u8l, u8u, u8v;
3774 v_load_deinterleave(src, u8l, u8u, u8v);
3775
3776 v_int32 xiv[4], yiv[4], ziv[4];
3777
3778 processLuvToXYZ(u8l, u8u, u8v, xiv, yiv, ziv);
3779
3780 // [xxyyzz]
3781 v_uint16 xyz[6];
3782 xyz[0] = v_pack_u(xiv[0], xiv[1]); xyz[1] = v_pack_u(xiv[2], xiv[3]);
3783 xyz[2] = v_pack_u(yiv[0], yiv[1]); xyz[3] = v_pack_u(yiv[2], yiv[3]);
3784 xyz[4] = v_pack_u(ziv[0], ziv[1]); xyz[5] = v_pack_u(ziv[2], ziv[3]);
3785
3786 // ro = CV_DESCALE(C0 * x + C1 * y + C2 * z, shift);
3787 // go = CV_DESCALE(C3 * x + C4 * y + C5 * z, shift);
3788 // bo = CV_DESCALE(C6 * x + C7 * y + C8 * z, shift);
3789
3790 // fix 16bit multiplication: c_i*v = c_i*(v-fixmul) + c_i*fixmul
3791 v_uint16 fixmul = vx_setall_u16(1 << (base_shift-1));
3792 v_int16 sxyz[6];
3793 for(int k = 0; k < 6; k++)
3794 {
3795 sxyz[k] = v_reinterpret_as_s16(v_sub_wrap(xyz[k], fixmul));
3796 }
3797
3798 v_int16 xy[4], zd[4];
3799 v_zip(sxyz[0], sxyz[2], xy[0], xy[1]);
3800 v_zip(sxyz[4], vdescale, zd[0], zd[1]);
3801 v_zip(sxyz[1], sxyz[3], xy[2], xy[3]);
3802 v_zip(sxyz[5], vdescale, zd[2], zd[3]);
3803
3804 // [rrrrggggbbbb]
3805 v_int32 i_rgb[4*3];
3806 // a bit faster than one loop for all
3807 for(int k = 0; k < 4; k++)
3808 {
3809 i_rgb[k+4*0] = v_shr<shift>(v_add(v_add(v_dotprod(xy[k], crxy), v_dotprod(zd[k], crz1)), fm[0]));
3810 }
3811 for(int k = 0; k < 4; k++)
3812 {
3813 i_rgb[k+4*1] = v_shr<shift>(v_add(v_add(v_dotprod(xy[k], cgxy), v_dotprod(zd[k], cgz1)), fm[1]));
3814 }
3815 for(int k = 0; k < 4; k++)
3816 {
3817 i_rgb[k+4*2] = v_shr<shift>(v_add(v_add(v_dotprod(xy[k], cbxy), v_dotprod(zd[k], cbz1)), fm[2]));
3818 }
3819
3820 // [rrggbb]
3821 v_uint16 u_rgbvec[6];
3822
3823 // limit indices in table and then substitute
3824 v_int32 z32 = vx_setzero_s32();
3825 v_int32 tabsz = vx_setall_s32((int)INV_GAMMA_TAB_SIZE-1);
3826 for(int k = 0; k < 12; k++)
3827 {
3828 i_rgb[k] = v_max(z32, v_min(tabsz, i_rgb[k]));
3829 }
3830
3831 // ro = tab[ro]; go = tab[go]; bo = tab[bo];
3832 if(srgb)
3833 {
3834 // [rr.., gg.., bb..]
3835 int32_t CV_DECL_ALIGNED(CV_SIMD_WIDTH) rgbshifts[3*VTraits<v_uint8>::max_nlanes];
3836 for(int k = 0; k < 12; k++)
3837 {
3838 v_store_aligned(rgbshifts + k*vsize/4, i_rgb[k]);
3839 }
3840 for(int k = 0; k < 6; k++)
3841 {
3842 u_rgbvec[k] = vx_lut(tab, rgbshifts + k*vsize/2);
3843 }
3844 }
3845 else
3846 {
3847 // rgb = (rgb*255) >> inv_gamma_shift
3848 for(int k = 0; k < 12; k++)
3849 {
3850 i_rgb[k] = v_shr((v_sub((v_shl(i_rgb[k], 8)), i_rgb[k])), inv_gamma_shift);
3851 }
3852
3853 for(int k = 0; k < 6; k++)
3854 {
3855 u_rgbvec[k] = v_reinterpret_as_u16(v_pack(i_rgb[k*2+0], i_rgb[k*2+1]));
3856 }
3857 }
3858
3859 v_uint8 u8_b, u8_g, u8_r;
3860 u8_r = v_pack(u_rgbvec[0], u_rgbvec[1]);
3861 u8_g = v_pack(u_rgbvec[2], u_rgbvec[3]);
3862 u8_b = v_pack(u_rgbvec[4], u_rgbvec[5]);
3863
3864 if(dcn == 4)
3865 {
3866 v_store_interleave(dst, u8_b, u8_g, u8_r, vx_setall_u8(alpha));
3867 }
3868 else
3869 {
3870 v_store_interleave(dst, u8_b, u8_g, u8_r);
3871 }
3872 }
3873 }
3874#endif
3875
3876 for (; i < n; i++, src += 3, dst += dcn)
3877 {
3878 int ro, go, bo;
3879 process(src[0], src[1], src[2], ro, go, bo);
3880
3881 dst[0] = saturate_cast<uchar>(bo);
3882 dst[1] = saturate_cast<uchar>(go);
3883 dst[2] = saturate_cast<uchar>(ro);
3884 if( dcn == 4 )
3885 dst[3] = alpha;
3886 }
3887
3888 }
3889
3890 int dstcn;
3891 int coeffs[9];
3892 bool issRGB;
3893};
3894
3895
3896struct Luv2RGB_b
3897{
3898 typedef uchar channel_type;
3899
3900 Luv2RGB_b( int _dstcn, int blueIdx, const float* _coeffs,
3901 const float* _whitept, bool _srgb )
3902 : dstcn(_dstcn),
3903 fcvt(3, blueIdx, _coeffs, _whitept, _srgb),
3904 icvt(_dstcn, blueIdx, _coeffs, _whitept, _srgb)
3905 {
3906 // whitept is fixed for int calculations
3907 useBitExactness = (!_whitept && enableBitExactness);
3908 }
3909
3910 void operator()(const uchar* src, uchar* dst, int n) const
3911 {
3912 CV_INSTRUMENT_REGION();
3913
3914 if(useBitExactness)
3915 {
3916 icvt(src, dst, n);
3917 return;
3918 }
3919
3920 int i, j, dcn = dstcn;
3921 uchar alpha = ColorChannel<uchar>::max();
3922#if CV_SIMD
3923 float CV_DECL_ALIGNED(CV_SIMD_WIDTH) buf[3*BLOCK_SIZE];
3924#else
3925 float CV_DECL_ALIGNED(16) buf[3*BLOCK_SIZE];
3926#endif
3927
3928 static const softfloat fl = softfloat(100)/f255;
3929 static const softfloat fu = uRange/f255;
3930 static const softfloat fv = vRange/f255;
3931
3932#if CV_SIMD
3933 const int fsize = VTraits<v_float32>::vlanes();
3934 v_float32 vl = vx_setall_f32((float)fl);
3935 v_float32 vu = vx_setall_f32((float)fu);
3936 v_float32 vv = vx_setall_f32((float)fv);
3937 v_float32 vuLow = vx_setall_f32((float)uLow), vvLow = vx_setall_f32((float)vLow);
3938 //TODO: fix that when v_interleave is available
3939 float CV_DECL_ALIGNED(CV_SIMD_WIDTH) interTmpM[VTraits<v_float32>::max_nlanes*3], interTmpA[VTraits<v_float32>::max_nlanes*3];
3940 v_store_interleave(interTmpM, vl, vu, vv);
3941 v_store_interleave(interTmpA, vx_setzero_f32(), vuLow, vvLow);
3942 v_float32 mluv[3], aluv[3];
3943 for(int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
3944 {
3945 mluv[k] = vx_load_aligned(interTmpM + k*fsize);
3946 aluv[k] = vx_load_aligned(interTmpA + k*fsize);
3947 }
3948#endif
3949
3950 i = 0;
3951 for( ; i < n; i += BLOCK_SIZE, src += BLOCK_SIZE*3 )
3952 {
3953 int dn = std::min(n - i, (int)BLOCK_SIZE);
3954 j = 0;
3955
3956#if CV_SIMD
3957 const int vsize = VTraits<v_uint8>::vlanes();
3958 for( ; j <= (dn - vsize)*3; j += 3*vsize )
3959 {
3960 v_uint8 s0, s1, s2;
3961 s0 = vx_load(src + j + 0*vsize);
3962 s1 = vx_load(src + j + 1*vsize);
3963 s2 = vx_load(src + j + 2*vsize);
3964
3965 v_uint16 ss[6];
3966 v_expand(s0, ss[0], ss[1]);
3967 v_expand(s1, ss[2], ss[3]);
3968 v_expand(s2, ss[4], ss[5]);
3969 v_int32 vs[12];
3970 for(int k = 0; k < 6; k++)
3971 {
3972 v_expand(v_reinterpret_as_s16(ss[k]), vs[k*2+0], vs[k*2+1]);
3973 }
3974
3975 for(int bufp = 0; bufp < 12; bufp++)
3976 {
3977 v_store_aligned(buf + j + bufp, v_muladd(v_cvt_f32(vs[bufp]), mluv[bufp%3], aluv[bufp%3]));
3978 }
3979 }
3980#endif
3981 for( ; j < dn*3; j += 3 )
3982 {
3983 buf[j] = src[j]*((float)fl);
3984 buf[j+1] = (float)(src[j+1]*(float)fu + (float)uLow);
3985 buf[j+2] = (float)(src[j+2]*(float)fv + (float)vLow);
3986 }
3987
3988 fcvt(buf, buf, dn);
3989
3990 j = 0;
3991
3992#if CV_SIMD
3993 static const int nBlock = 4*fsize;
3994 v_float32 v255 = vx_setall_f32(255.f);
3995 if(dcn == 4)
3996 {
3997 v_uint8 valpha = vx_setall_u8(alpha);
3998 for( ; j <= (dn-nBlock)*3;
3999 j += nBlock*3, dst += nBlock)
4000 {
4001 v_float32 vf[4*3];
4002 for(int k = 0; k < 4; k++)
4003 {
4004 v_load_deinterleave(buf + j, vf[k*3+0], vf[k*3+1], vf[k*3+2]);
4005 }
4006
4007 v_int32 vi[4*3];
4008 for(int k = 0; k < 4*3; k++)
4009 {
4010 vi[k] = v_round(v_mul(vf[k], v255));
4011 }
4012
4013 v_uint8 rgb[3];
4014 for(int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
4015 {
4016 rgb[k] = v_pack_u(v_pack(vi[0*3+k], vi[1*3+k]),
4017 v_pack(vi[2*3+k], vi[3*3+k]));
4018 }
4019
4020 v_store_interleave(dst, rgb[0], rgb[1], rgb[2], valpha);
4021 }
4022 }
4023 else // dcn == 3
4024 {
4025 for(; j < dn*3 - nBlock; j += nBlock, dst += nBlock)
4026 {
4027 v_float32 vf[4];
4028 v_int32 vi[4];
4029 for(int k = 0; k < 4; k++)
4030 {
4031 vf[k] = vx_load_aligned(buf + j + k*fsize);
4032 vi[k] = v_round(v_mul(vf[k], v255));
4033 }
4034 v_store(dst, v_pack_u(v_pack(vi[0], vi[1]), v_pack(vi[2], vi[3])));
4035 }
4036 }
4037#endif
4038
4039 for( ; j < dn*3; j += 3, dst += dcn )
4040 {
4041 dst[0] = saturate_cast<uchar>(buf[j]*255.f);
4042 dst[1] = saturate_cast<uchar>(buf[j+1]*255.f);
4043 dst[2] = saturate_cast<uchar>(buf[j+2]*255.f);
4044 if( dcn == 4 )
4045 dst[3] = alpha;
4046 }
4047 }
4048 }
4049
4050 int dstcn;
4051 Luv2RGBfloat fcvt;
4052 Luv2RGBinteger icvt;
4053
4054 bool useBitExactness;
4055};

4064void cvtBGRtoXYZ(const uchar * src_data, size_t src_step,
4065 uchar * dst_data, size_t dst_step,
4066 int width, int height,
4067 int depth, int scn, bool swapBlue)
4068{
4069 CV_INSTRUMENT_REGION();
4070
4071 CALL_HAL(cvtBGRtoXYZ, cv_hal_cvtBGRtoXYZ, src_data, src_step, dst_data, dst_step, width, height, depth, scn, swapBlue);
4072
4073 int blueIdx = swapBlue ? 2 : 0;
4074 if( depth == CV_8U )
4075 CvtColorLoop(src_data, src_step, dst_data, dst_step, width, height, RGB2XYZ_i<uchar>(scn, blueIdx, 0));
4076 else if( depth == CV_16U )
4077 CvtColorLoop(src_data, src_step, dst_data, dst_step, width, height, RGB2XYZ_i<ushort>(scn, blueIdx, 0));
4078 else
4079 CvtColorLoop(src_data, src_step, dst_data, dst_step, width, height, RGB2XYZ_f<float>(scn, blueIdx, 0));
4080}

4159//
4160// OCL calls
4161//
4162
4163#ifdef HAVE_OPENCL
4164
4165bool oclCvtColorBGR2Luv( InputArray _src, OutputArray _dst, int bidx, bool srgb)
4166{
4167 OclHelper< Set<3, 4>, Set<3>, Set<CV_8U, CV_32F> > h(_src, _dst, 3);
4168
4169 if(!h.createKernel("BGR2Luv", ocl::imgproc::color_lab_oclsrc,
4170 format("-D DCN=3 -D BIDX=%d%s", bidx, srgb ? " -D SRGB" : "")))
4171 {
4172 return false;
4173 }
4174
4175 // Prepare additional arguments
4176
4177 initLabTabs();
4178
4179 static UMat usRGBGammaTab, ucoeffs, uLabCbrtTab;
4180
4181 if (srgb && usRGBGammaTab.empty())
4182 Mat(1, GAMMA_TAB_SIZE * 4, CV_32FC1, const_cast<float*>(sRGBGammaTab)).copyTo(usRGBGammaTab);
4183 if (uLabCbrtTab.empty())
4184 Mat(1, LAB_CBRT_TAB_SIZE * 4, CV_32FC1, const_cast<float*>(LabCbrtTab)).copyTo(uLabCbrtTab);
4185
4186 float coeffs[9];
4187 softdouble whitePt[3];
4188 for(int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
4189 whitePt[i] = D65[i];
4190
4191 for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
4192 {
4193 int j = i * 3;
4194
4195 softfloat c0 = sRGB2XYZ_D65[j ];
4196 softfloat c1 = sRGB2XYZ_D65[j + 1];
4197 softfloat c2 = sRGB2XYZ_D65[j + 2];
4198
4199 coeffs[j + (bidx ^ 2)] = c0;
4200 coeffs[j + 1] = c1;
4201 coeffs[j + bidx] = c2;
4202
4203 CV_Assert( c0 >= 0 && c1 >= 0 && c2 >= 0 &&
4204 c0 + c1 + c2 < softfloat(3)/softfloat(2));
4205 }
4206
4207 softfloat d = whitePt[0] +
4208 whitePt[1]*softdouble(15) +
4209 whitePt[2]*softdouble(3);
4210 d = softfloat::one()/max(d, softfloat(FLT_EPSILON));
4211 float un = d*softfloat(13*4)*whitePt[0];
4212 float vn = d*softfloat(13*9)*whitePt[1];
4213
4214 Mat(1, 9, CV_32FC1, coeffs).copyTo(ucoeffs);
4215
4216 ocl::KernelArg ucoeffsarg = ocl::KernelArg::PtrReadOnly(ucoeffs);
4217
4218 ocl::KernelArg LabCbrtTabarg = ocl::KernelArg::PtrReadOnly(uLabCbrtTab);
4219
4220 // Setup additional arguments and run
4221
4222 if(srgb)
4223 h.setArg(ocl::KernelArg::PtrReadOnly(usRGBGammaTab));
4224
4225 h.setArg(LabCbrtTabarg);
4226 h.setArg(ucoeffsarg);
4227 h.setArg(un); h.setArg(vn);
4228
4229 return h.run();
4230}
4231
4232
4233bool oclCvtColorBGR2Lab( InputArray _src, OutputArray _dst, int bidx, bool srgb )
4234{
4235 OclHelper< Set<3, 4>, Set<3>, Set<CV_8U, CV_32F> > h(_src, _dst, 3);
4236
4237 if(!h.createKernel("BGR2Lab", ocl::imgproc::color_lab_oclsrc,
4238 format("-D DCN=3 -D BIDX=%d%s", bidx, srgb ? " -D SRGB" : "")))
4239 {
4240 return false;
4241 }
4242
4243 // Prepare and set additional arguments
4244
4245 initLabTabs();
4246
4247 if (_src.depth() == CV_8U)
4248 {
4249 static UMat usRGBGammaTab, ulinearGammaTab, uLabCbrtTab, ucoeffs;
4250
4251 if (srgb && usRGBGammaTab.empty())
4252 Mat(1, 256, CV_16UC1, sRGBGammaTab_b).copyTo(usRGBGammaTab);
4253 else if (ulinearGammaTab.empty())
4254 Mat(1, 256, CV_16UC1, linearGammaTab_b).copyTo(ulinearGammaTab);
4255 if (uLabCbrtTab.empty())
4256 Mat(1, LAB_CBRT_TAB_SIZE_B, CV_16UC1, LabCbrtTab_b).copyTo(uLabCbrtTab);
4257
4258 int coeffs[9];
4259 static const softfloat lshift(1 << lab_shift);
4260 for( int i = 0; i < 3; i++ )
4261 {
4262 coeffs[i*3+(bidx^2)] = cvRound(lshift*sRGB2XYZ_D65[i*3 ]/D65[i]);
4263 coeffs[i*3+1] = cvRound(lshift*sRGB2XYZ_D65[i*3+1]/D65[i]);
4264 coeffs[i*3+bidx] = cvRound(lshift*sRGB2XYZ_D65[i*3+2]/D65[i]);
4265
4266 CV_Assert(coeffs[i*3] >= 0 && coeffs[i*3+1] >= 0 && coeffs[i*3+2] >= 0 &&
4267 coeffs[i*3] + coeffs[i*3+1] + coeffs[i*3+2] < 2*(1 << lab_shift));
4268 }
4269 Mat(1, 9, CV_32SC1, coeffs).copyTo(ucoeffs);
4270
4271 const int Lscale = (116*255+50)/100;
4272 const int Lshift = -((16*255*(1 << lab_shift2) + 50)/100);
4273
4274 h.setArg(ocl::KernelArg::PtrReadOnly(srgb ? usRGBGammaTab : ulinearGammaTab));
4275 h.setArg(ocl::KernelArg::PtrReadOnly(uLabCbrtTab));
4276 h.setArg(ocl::KernelArg::PtrReadOnly(ucoeffs));
4277 h.setArg(Lscale); h.setArg(Lshift);
4278 }
4279 else
4280 {
4281 static UMat usRGBGammaTab, ucoeffs;
4282
4283 if (srgb && usRGBGammaTab.empty())
4284 Mat(1, GAMMA_TAB_SIZE * 4, CV_32FC1, const_cast<float*>(sRGBGammaTab)).copyTo(usRGBGammaTab);
4285
4286 softdouble whitePt[3];
4287 for(int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
4288 whitePt[i] = D65[i];
4289
4290 softdouble scale[] = { softdouble::one() / whitePt[0],
4291 softdouble::one(),
4292 softdouble::one() / whitePt[2] };
4293
4294 float coeffs[9];
4295 for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
4296 {
4297 int j = i * 3;
4298
4299 softfloat c0 = scale[i] * sRGB2XYZ_D65[j ];
4300 softfloat c1 = scale[i] * sRGB2XYZ_D65[j + 1];
4301 softfloat c2 = scale[i] * sRGB2XYZ_D65[j + 2];
4302
4303 coeffs[j + (bidx ^ 2)] = c0;
4304 coeffs[j + 1] = c1;
4305 coeffs[j + bidx] = c2;
4306
4307 CV_Assert( c0 >= 0 && c1 >= 0 && c2 >= 0 &&
4308 c0 + c1 + c2 < softfloat((int)LAB_CBRT_TAB_SIZE));
4309 }
4310
4311 Mat(1, 9, CV_32FC1, coeffs).copyTo(ucoeffs);
4312
4313 static const float _a = softfloat(16)/softfloat(116);
4314 static const float _1_3f = softfloat::one()/softfloat(3);
4315 ocl::KernelArg ucoeffsarg = ocl::KernelArg::PtrReadOnly(ucoeffs);
4316
4317 if (srgb)
4318 h.setArg(ocl::KernelArg::PtrReadOnly(usRGBGammaTab));
4319
4320 h.setArg(ucoeffsarg);
4321 h.setArg(_1_3f); h.setArg(_a);
4322 }
4323
4324 return h.run();
4325}

4327
4328bool oclCvtColorLab2BGR(InputArray _src, OutputArray _dst, int dcn, int bidx, bool srgb)
4329{
4330 OclHelper< Set<3>, Set<3, 4>, Set<CV_8U, CV_32F> > h(_src, _dst, dcn);
4331
4332 if(!h.createKernel("Lab2BGR", ocl::imgproc::color_lab_oclsrc,
4333 format("-D DCN=%d -D BIDX=%d%s", dcn, bidx, srgb ? " -D SRGB" : "")))
4334 {
4335 return false;
4336 }
4337
4338 // Prepare additional arguments
4339
4340 initLabTabs();
4341
4342 static UMat ucoeffs, usRGBInvGammaTab;
4343
4344 if (srgb && usRGBInvGammaTab.empty())
4345 Mat(1, GAMMA_TAB_SIZE*4, CV_32FC1, const_cast<float*>(sRGBInvGammaTab)).copyTo(usRGBInvGammaTab);
4346
4347 float coeffs[9];
4348 softdouble whitePt[3];
4349 for(int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
4350 whitePt[i] = D65[i];
4351
4352 for( int i = 0; i < 3; i++ )
4353 {
4354 coeffs[i+(bidx^2)*3] = (float)(XYZ2sRGB_D65[i ]*whitePt[i]);
4355 coeffs[i+3] = (float)(XYZ2sRGB_D65[i+3]*whitePt[i]);
4356 coeffs[i+bidx*3] = (float)(XYZ2sRGB_D65[i+6]*whitePt[i]);
4357 }
4358
4359 Mat(1, 9, CV_32FC1, coeffs).copyTo(ucoeffs);
4360
4361 float lThresh = softfloat(8); // 0.008856f * 903.3f = (6/29)^3*(29/3)^3 = 8
4362 float fThresh = softfloat(6)/softfloat(29); // 7.787f * 0.008856f + 16.0f / 116.0f = 6/29
4363
4364 ocl::KernelArg coeffsarg = ocl::KernelArg::PtrReadOnly(ucoeffs);
4365
4366 // Set additional arguments and run
4367
4368 if(srgb)
4369 h.setArg(ocl::KernelArg::PtrReadOnly(usRGBInvGammaTab));
4370
4371 h.setArg(coeffsarg);
4372 h.setArg(lThresh);
4373 h.setArg(fThresh);
4374
4375 return h.run();
4376}

4378
4379bool oclCvtColorLuv2BGR(InputArray _src, OutputArray _dst, int dcn, int bidx, bool srgb)
4380{
4381 OclHelper< Set<3>, Set<3, 4>, Set<CV_8U, CV_32F> > h(_src, _dst, dcn);
4382
4383 if(!h.createKernel("Luv2BGR", ocl::imgproc::color_lab_oclsrc,
4384 format("-D DCN=%d -D BIDX=%d%s", dcn, bidx, srgb ? " -D SRGB" : "")))
4385 {
4386 return false;
4387 }
4388
4389 // Prepare additional arguments
4390
4391 initLabTabs();
4392
4393 static UMat ucoeffs, usRGBInvGammaTab;
4394
4395 if (srgb && usRGBInvGammaTab.empty())
4396 Mat(1, GAMMA_TAB_SIZE*4, CV_32FC1, const_cast<float*>(sRGBInvGammaTab)).copyTo(usRGBInvGammaTab);
4397
4398 float coeffs[9];
4399 softdouble whitePt[3];
4400 for(int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
4401 whitePt[i] = D65[i];
4402
4403 for( int i = 0; i < 3; i++ )
4404 {
4405 coeffs[i+(bidx^2)*3] = (float)(XYZ2sRGB_D65[i ]);
4406 coeffs[i+3] = (float)(XYZ2sRGB_D65[i+3]);
4407 coeffs[i+bidx*3] = (float)(XYZ2sRGB_D65[i+6]);
4408 }
4409
4410 softfloat d = whitePt[0] +
4411 whitePt[1]*softdouble(15) +
4412 whitePt[2]*softdouble(3);
4413 d = softfloat::one()/max(d, softfloat(FLT_EPSILON));
4414 float un = softfloat(4*13)*d*whitePt[0];
4415 float vn = softfloat(9*13)*d*whitePt[1];
4416
4417 Mat(1, 9, CV_32FC1, coeffs).copyTo(ucoeffs);
4418
4419 ocl::KernelArg coeffsarg = ocl::KernelArg::PtrReadOnly(ucoeffs);
4420
4421 // Set additional arguments and run
4422
4423 if(srgb)
4424 h.setArg(ocl::KernelArg::PtrReadOnly(usRGBInvGammaTab));
4425
4426 h.setArg(coeffsarg);
4427 h.setArg(un); h.setArg(vn);
4428
4429 return h.run();
4430}
